title: Orchestrate chroma anchors and type velocity for responsive components
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Goal: refresh the system token set to introduce a small set of stable chroma anchors and a proportional typography velocity scale so components behave predictably across breakpoints and density modes. This work combines palette rationalization (anchoring key hues for brand/neutral/interactive states), a breathing-type scale that preserves optical sizes across 14–20px ranges, and companion spacing/radius/elevation adjustments targeted at dense tables and compact widgets.
scope:
- Create chroma anchors (6 anchors: neutral, brand, success, warning, danger, accent) with accessible deltas for light/dark modes.
- Define a type velocity scale (steps that map to responsive breakpoints and compact mode).
- Propose spacing and corner presets that align with the new type scale.
- Rework minor elevation steps for table rows and floating controls to keep perceived depth minimal in dense layouts.
- Deliver token files (JSON/SCSS), Figma token variables, migration instructions, and a migration PR template for component owners.
acceptance_criteria:
- New chroma anchors committed to tokens repo as v2.3 and referenced in Figma file 'DS/Tokens/ChromaAnchors' URL below.
- Body text contrast >= 4.5:1 for default scales; interactive colors meet WCAG 2.1 AA.
- Typography velocity scale defined and applied to Button, Input, Table row, and Card components in the component playground.
- Spacing/radius presets included and a migration guide with codemods for 80% of core components.
- Visual regression run shows no >2% pixel diffs for key screens (Dashboard list, Table heavy, Compact forms).
- PRs created for tokens and at least three component updates (buttons, tables, charts) with design sign-off.
design_decisions:
- Chroma anchors: choose 6 anchors only to limit cognitive complexity and interpolation edge cases. We will generate semantic ramps from anchors rather than hand-crafting every shade.
- Typography: use modular scale with smaller ratios (1.125) for density-sensitive interfaces to reduce line-height jumps.
- Spacing/Radius: favor proportional presets (e.g., 2,4,8,12) over pixel-exact values to simplify runtime sizing in compact mode.
- Elevation: reduce number of elevation layers for dense surfaces to avoid noisy shadows; prefer subtle overlays for hover states.
- Tradeoffs: interpolation simplifies maintenance but may produce hue shifts at extremes; we will lock key interactive colors as exceptions where necessary.
deliverables:
- tokens/v2.3/chroma-anchors.json (tokens repo)
- Figma: 'DS/Tokens/ChromaAnchors' and 'DS/Components/Responsive-Playground'
- Migration guide: docs/confluence/design/chroma-anchors-migration.md
- Codemod: scripts/migrate-spacing-radius-codemod.js (example PR linked)
- Component updates: PRs for button, table, chart; playground smoke tests updated
- Rollout plan and canary checklist

migration_strategy:
- Phase 1: land tokens behind feature flag; components read anchors when flag enabled.
- Phase 2: run codemod on repo subset and update canary customers.
- Phase 3: flip default for new apps and deprecate legacy tokens after 8 weeks.
- Rollback plan: restore old tokens flag and publish hotfix for components (estimated <4 hours).
